name: EffectCraft
description: Create and edit motion-graphics compositions, effects and keyframes headlessly; render previews and finished media.
progressive_guidance: The CLI downloads automatically from the pinned release archives. Operations run headlessly without opening a window or requiring a generation-provider account. Discover command IDs and params before editing. Ordinary edits stage a source copy and publish new files. Engine commands with explicit paths can still access the local filesystem; use file, script, preference or destructive operations only when explicitly requested. Preserve originals and inspect diagnostics. A successful command is not proof of visual quality: inspect a rendered preview before delivering artwork or video.

commands.description: Discover motion-graphics engine commands and parameter documentation.

filter.description: Text to search in the installed command registry.

inspect.description: Inspect the project, active composition and layer tree without editing.

edit.description: Create an empty composition project or edit a source copy; attach the new .ecproj file.

command.description: An engine command ID observed through commands.

params.description: Parameters discovered from the installed command registry.

inputPath.description: Absolute existing project/document. Omit to start a new empty project.

edit.progressive_guidance: Use observed comp.new parameters to create a composition, then layer/effect/property commands. Params use native composition IDs or names and layer IDs as documented by commands. Use inspect and preview on the returned project before rendering. .aep/.aepx files and After Effects plug-ins are unsupported.

preview.description: Render one composition frame to PNG and attach bounded model evidence.

timeSeconds.description: Seconds from the composition start; defaults to zero.

comp.description: Observed composition name or ID. Omit for the active composition.

render.description: Render a composition to completed MP4, GIF or WAV and attach it as an artifact.

comp.description: Observed composition name or ID. Omit for the active composition.

render.progressive_guidance: Defaults to MP4 and the full composition. Inspect duration and preview relevant frames first. Rendering uses the CPU and the profile timeout; a returned execution handle is pending work, not finished output.
